item.title: BELFAST airports combined passenger numbers up 2.2pc in January
item.description: The two Belfast airports handled 560,068 passengers in January 2026, up 2.2pc on 2025 and 7.4pc on pre-pandemic. Belfast international handled 388,637 passengers, down slightly 0.5pc on 2025 and up 2.3pc on pre-pandemic. Belfast City handled 171,431 passengers, up 8.5pc on 2024 and 22.1pc on pre pandemic.
